description: Release Anxiety Tonight | Slow Bansuri | 1.5 Hours of Indian Classical Music to release anxiety and quiet the thoughts that won't switch off.

When the day leaves your mind racing, let the bansuri slow it down. Ninety minutes of soft, breathy bamboo flute in Raga Bageshri — tender, intimate, and unhurried — made to play in the background while you let the tension drain, breathe, and finally set the day's worries down for the night.
No ads breaking the calm. Just continuous Indian classical flute music to ease anxiety and an overactive mind.
Best for: releasing anxiety · a mind that won't stop · negative thoughts · evening wind-down · letting the day go.
Put it on, let your shoulders drop, and let the anxiety loosen its grip. 🌙
suno_prompt: Instrumental only, no vocals, no humming — soft breathy Indian classical bansuri (bamboo flute) in Raga Bageshri, intimate flute with slow meend glides and long sustained notes over a gentle tanpura drone, NO tabla, unhurried ~58 BPM, tender late-evening character that releases anxiety and quiets a busy mind, seamless loop.
